note: Book metadata and chapter titles are factual references taken from NCERT's official prelims PDFs (contents pages). NCERT textbooks are (c) NCERT, all rights reserved; no textbook text is reproduced beyond titles. 'contentSummary' is the dataset editors' own short description inferred from section headings and keyword search of the chapter PDFs; it is NOT an official syllabus statement. 'ncfCompetencies' per chapter is an editor inference, not an NCERT mapping. Chapter numbering restarts at 1 in Part II books (GP7-2, GP8-2), so always key chapters by book.
